create_elasticsearch_client: create an ElasticsearchClient vector database instance connected to a configured Elasticsearch cluster
insert_vector_items: insert a list of vector items with embeddings, text, and metadata into an Elasticsearch collection
search_similar_vectors: search a collection for similar vectors using cosine similarity and return ranked results
upsert_vector_items: upsert vector items into an Elasticsearch collection, creating or updating documents by id
delete_collection_documents: delete documents from an Elasticsearch collection by ids or metadata filter
